name: kogaki
description: The Japanese-realization Lint (kogaki#1158, kogaki#1162) depends on textlint, its technical-writing preset, and textlint-rule-prh; the src/ lane rule (kogaki#1746) depends on dependency-cruiser; the JavaScript lint (kogaki#1747) depends on eslint, @eslint/js, eslint-plugin-import-x and globals; the coverage digest (kogaki#1793) depends on c8; the type check (kogaki#1791) depends on typescript and @types/node; the formatter (kogaki#1792) depends on prettier; nothing else in this repository carries an npm dependency.
